hook_line: ANIL MENON COMPLETES NASA'S 100TH US SPACEWALK

hook_stat.sub: US spacewalk conducted from the station's Quest airlock

stats.label: Spacewalk in support of the ISS overall
Full length of the roll-out solar array installed
More station power once the eighth and final array is installed

diaspora_bullets: It was Menon's fourth spacewalk and Kutryk's first
The final array, due November 5, completes the power upgrade
news_summary: NASA astronaut Anil Menon and Canada's Joshua Kutryk spent 7 hours and 11 minutes outside the International Space Station on October 29, installing its seventh roll-out solar array.
payoff: Once the eighth and final array is installed on November 5, the upgrade will raise the station's available power by up to 30 percent.
